The '''Korriban Orbital Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the subsequent [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Korriban Orbital Station was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It serves as the spaceport for the Empire-only planet Korriban, and can only be accessed by Imperial players with their own ship. Players then can take a shuttle down to the Sith Academy on the planet's surface.<ref name="TOR" />
